alt: Four narrative voices: first person, with intimacy, limited knowledge and a question of reliability; third-person omniscient, moving between minds; third-person limited, close to one character; and free indirect discourse, which blends third-person grammar with a character’s vocabulary and attitude. caption: Ask who tells the story and whose perspective shapes each scene.
